summary: Franklin County tower the FFLA lists as standing; no build date, design or history found, and the listed point may not be the York Hill near Weld.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists York Hill in Franklin County as a standing tower at 44.59676, -69.97355
a York Hill near Weld sits at 44.67658 north
the same York Hill sits at -70.37558 west
that York Hill's approximate elevation is 1,440 ft
the Eastern US Lookouts Maine page has a York Hill entry in Franklin County with no details

sources.title: York Hill in Franklin County ME (Weld Area)

notes_for_editor: Two York Hills in Franklin County: the FFLA point (44.59676, -69.97355) and the MountainZone summit near Weld (44.67658, -70.37558). By my calculation the two points are about 33 km apart, so it is not certain which hill the FFLA tower is on. Confirm the point before accepting it. No build date, design, owner, staffing or history was found; two searches turned up no account of the tower. The story is deliberately short.
